svg.title: W-08 New soundcheck wireframe
svg.text: /app/soundcheck/new (POST /api/v1/channels/[id]/soundchecks, then a chunked upload) · UC-15, UC-16, UC-17
Upload a rough cut, or link a public or unlisted video. In a few minutes you'll see how long each audience is likely to watch it.
It matters most for newcomers: where they come from changes how they watch.
Uploads are used only for this soundcheck and are deleted after 30 days.
Public or unlisted. A private video can't be watched: set it to Unlisted.
Uploading 506 MB of 1,204 MB. Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
Error (refused before or by the API)
This file is over 2 GB. Export a smaller file and try again.
Also: MP4, MOV or WebM only · not a YouTube link · upload expired · cancelled
There is no empty form: without a published summary the page redirects to /app/soundcheck (W-07).
Radio group: a file or a YouTube link. Switching clears the error.
Drop or choose a file. Type and size are checked here (fileProblem) and again by the API (415, 413).
Scenario: Like my recent videos, Mostly search, Mostly suggested, Mostly subscribers. It sets the audience
→ Run soundcheck (file) → 201 → PUT chunks straight to Cloud Storage → W-09
